question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**account.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given sentence, the blank will imply how the farmers in early days had to keep track of the stored crops.**
 
• **Thus, among the given options, the correct word to use is "account."**
 
 
• "Account" means to keep track of something, usually in a financial sense.(लेखा)
 
 
• Grammatically, it is a verb.
 
• Example: "I need to account for all of my expenses this month."
 
 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Undercount" means to count something as less than the actual amount.(कम गिनती)
 
• "Discount" means to reduce the price or value of something.(छूट)
 
• "Count" means to determine the number or amount of something.(गिनती करना)
